# Dealer Agent Protocol
> Open MCP standard for car dealership inventory, availability, and pricing disclosure, so AI agents answer shoppers with the dealer's real price, real fees, and current availability. Apache-2.0. Reference gateway and synthetic test data available.

Dealer Agent Protocol (DAP) covers dealer and rooftop identity, published vehicle inventory, authoritative availability, advertised prices, required dealer charges, discounts, incentives, provenance, freshness, uncertainty, a separately claimed consented handoff, and a provider-neutral used-vehicle profile for mileage, inventory tenure, history, title, inspection, certification, warranty, reconditioning, and source conflicts.

DAP is not Auto Agent Protocol (AAP). AAP is an A2A automotive profile. DAP is MCP-native and publishes an optional A2A extension and bridge.

Dealer Agent Protocol is the open specification and conformance contract. Dealer Agent Gateway is open reference software that implements the protocol. MCP is the transport used between agents and gateways.

- Streamable HTTP: https://mcp.dealershipmcp.com/mcp
- Health: https://mcp.dealershipmcp.com/health
- Data status: synthetic reference data only; never a production dealer claim

## License

Specification text, schemas, examples, conformance tests, and reference code are available under Apache License 2.0.

Dealer Agent Protocol was created by Ariel Coro. DealershipMCP is a Dealer Growth Hackers product and one implementation of the open standard.
